prompts.text: The morning train arrived exactly on time.
She carefully placed the old photographs back into the wooden box.
Rain fell steadily across the quiet valley throughout the afternoon.
He counted the coins twice before handing them to the shopkeeper.
A gentle breeze carried the scent of pine through the open window.
The committee agreed to postpone the decision until the following week.
Bright yellow flowers lined the narrow path leading up to the small cottage.
After dinner they walked along the shore and talked quietly about the future.
